modification_reason: Update to 2.17.1 to fix CVE-2026-34085 (off-by-one OOB write in FcFontCapabilities). Also added gorget source-pipeline.yaml (HUM-6093 audit finding): 2.17.1 was never published as an official dist tarball (freedesktop.org's release mirror stops at 2.16.0) -- repointed at a git fetch of the same tag, plus a temporary meson doc build to regenerate the man/txt/html files %install expects (a plain git checkout alone broke rpmbuild's %install: 'cannot stat doc/*.1').
